purpose: Dedicated generated external holdout for Phase 08 sandbox. Not the golden 10, not the 23 hand-authored seeds. Server-owned, deterministic, disjoint from Phase 07 training and internal eval pools.
notes: Caller requests tier + n only. Server samples from this pool; records generator seed/config on every run. Ground truth stays server-side. tier=all uses balanced sampling across tiers 1–3 (e.g. n=3 → one task per tier).
